lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Diagnostic events survive offline and temporary server failures
value.statement: Initialize only after the isolated-script guard and before the delegating local crash handler. Persist bounded SDK envelopes in private files storage before async HTTP; retain offline, 5xx and rate-limited failures, replay through SDK observers and a connected WorkManager job without reinitializing handlers. Event UUID and diagnostic stack/version/device/typed-operation context survive process restart. Preserve original historical identity, separate reporter identity, and reserve context/breadcrumb budget. GPS snapshot v4 retains callback age/delivery lag,24-sample history and episode warning/recovery/cancel pairing and adds raw measurement time. Only an emitted report may add the passive system-cache witness; source seed time is not callback receipt time, unknown remains explicit and causes are not inferred. Reception/acquisition/filter waits stay local; reporting thresholds and observer/device-sleep gaps remain unchanged. Journal writes await durability without losing caller cancellation. Do not read business storage, photos or raw HyperLog in crash callbacks. Supplied event data, original HTTP URLs/query/headers/cookies, response metadata, custom context and frame paths are retained without content masking under bounded serialization. Never consume streaming HTTP bodies for reporting. Fatal exceptions still delegate to Android and existing draft recovery remains independent. Limit new automatic handled SDK HTTP 5xx bursts; expected local tile GET 503 with explicit queue_full/heap_headroom remains in the bounded local journal. Unknown causes and remote failures retain the first request and status/source tags; never suppress fatal failures or cached replay. Historical OS exit context requires matching original timestamp, process and crash type on a background sender. Map runtime snapshots are bounded, captured without SDK/business reads from the observer and attached only to matching operation timestamps; old process identity is never replaced with the reporting process version. Queue and heap 503 reasons remain independently observable. API30+ SIGNALED exits also attempt the bounded OS trace stream. Auto parsing distinguishes native frames from a prior recovered-ANR main stack; association may_precede_exit remains explicit, and null/IO/unrecognized format are separate unknown states. Reason2/status6 alone never establishes native-crash type, OOM or the cause of the final exit.
